text: The rewritten table helper has seven Assert.equal calls and the new negative block has three. All ten omit the message argument. At these sites, add a nonempty message that names the property and expected result, including enough case context to locate a failing URL. This follows the deliberate assertion-message review rule; nearby comments and fixture values are not assertion messages. The finding does not depend on the word should being absent and does not authorize unrelated test rewrites.
title: Ten rewritten mailto assertions omit expected-result messages
